first_pass_desc: Label 'Year 1' appears above the line and a green money bag appears beside the character while the red line extends.
Red timeline line extends further right.
Label 'Year 15', a second pension check and a second money bag appear along the line, which extends.
Red timeline line extends further right.
Label 'Year 30' with a third check and money bag appear; line extends.
Red timeline line extends to the right.
Label 'Year 35+' with a fourth check and money bag appear; line extends to near the right edge.
Red line end extends a few pixels further right.
The definition card slides left and enlarges while a tall blue 'BIG BUSINESS' tower arrives at right.
A green dollar bill drops from the top and lands against the piggy bank.
Yellow highlight stripe extends rightward across the source footnote line.
Character swaps from surprised pose centre-right to a smiling pose lower-left of the chart with pointer stick aimed at chart; meme and 401K sheet stay. Machine class partial/additive was wrong.

Entire chart scene with meme, 401K sheet, BOND sheet and small character is replaced by one large smiling stick character, arms out, centred on blank canvas. Machine said partial replace; it is a full hard cut.
BOND sheet with '50 years!' replaced by a grey-haired woman with phone receiver at ear, purple tie, mouth open, left of centre, cropped at bottom.
Woman and speech bubble replaced by a centred OECD logo (globe plus chevrons plus grey wordmark); a tiny pen-start mark appears under the globe.
OECD logo with caption replaced by a full-frame world-map screenshot with orange member countries on grey, title at top and 'Source: World Population Review' at bottom.
Single-frame colour toggle of all highlighted member countries on the map between orange and bright green; map geometry, title and source unchanged. Looks like a deliberate blink effect.

World map replaced by a centred superhero-film title logo (purple metallic lettering with red studio badge above) on blank canvas.
Logo replaced by two cartoon country characters: small green US-shaped one at left with a round star shield, and a big dark Russia-shaped one with green face and red moustache at right.
Country characters replaced by a document-text screenshot (paragraph about pension funds and bonds) with source line, a cheque-and-money-bag icon at lower-left and OECD logo at lower-right.
Document text page replaced by a central-bank website screenshot (dark-blue banner, minutes page with body text columns) occupying centre of canvas with white margins.
The website screenshot scrolls up and is cropped: header banner leaves the top and body text moves upward, slightly larger.
Website page scales up to fill the frame (right column bar visible) while a smiling stick character with pointer enters at far right.
Zoomed page with highlighted text and pointing character replaced by one blank-canvas stick character with sweat drop and hands pressed together at centre-left.
Character replaced by a maroon paper-company logo card top-left with BOND sheet overlapping; the BOND sheet then slides right and a red curved arrow is drawn beside it.
Logo card scene replaced by a brown-haired character with glasses, green striped tie, hand on chin, worried face, left of centre and cropped at bottom.
Character and bubble replaced by a timeline diagram start: BOND sheet top-left, black tick below it, label 'Interest payments' lower-centre; a red dot begins the line.
Timeline diagram replaced by a green UK-map character with round eyes standing at far right of otherwise blank canvas.
A blue panel reading 'Office for Budget Responsibility' slides in from the left and settles behind the UK character at mid-right.
Bond note on the right is replaced by a pale-blue definition card titled 'Gilts' with certificate images, coin emblem and text 'Debt securities issued by the U.K. government.'
UK character and definition card replaced by a report page of dense text with a small highlight, two stacked bond notes bottom-left and a small UK character bottom-right.
Report page replaced by one frowning stick character with hands on hips, centred on blank canvas.
Frowning character replaced by a report page with area chart and bar chart at top, paragraph text below and a pointing stick character at lower-left.
Chart page replaced by an extreme close-up of a green country body with two big googly eyes and a wide grin, filling the whole frame.
Close-up face replaced by a small green UK character with a teacup and saucer at its left, centre-right on blank canvas.
